claims: C1: following user or developer instructions can cause harm
C2: harmful instructions include self-harm advice and advice that helps a violent act
C3: such situations are a direct conflict between empowerment and harm prevention

concepts.name: harmful_instruction
concepts.gloss: an instruction whose content, if followed, would cause harm, such as self-harm advice or advice that helps a violent act

concepts.name: self_harm_advice
concepts.gloss: an instruction that advises the user to harm themselves

concepts.name: violent_act_advice
concepts.gloss: an instruction that gives advice helping the user carry out a violent act

ontology.gloss: I is an instruction whose content risks causing harm, e.g. self-harm advice
I is an instruction whose content risks causing harm, e.g. advice that helps a violent act

asserts.read_back: following instruction % is forbidden because it is a harmful instruction

closure.reason: the clause forbids following harmful instructions but says nothing about following harmless ones; silence leaves those permitted
